These probabilities are priors from general knowledge of NAS-Bench-201, not computed from the benchmark data. Each rests on how I expect edge interactions to behave. Edges whose operation would be dead or disconnected tend to make an edit matter less. Parent conv operations tend to amplify the benefit of later convs. Interactions that stay consistent across all three datasets by a meaningful margin are uncommon, so most numbers are low.
